en: Astartes MK VII. Firing a charged energy blast along a powerful laser, the lascannon can cut through almost any armor at extreme range. It requires a substantial amount of time to build up its power before a shot, however. Effective against vehicles and structures.
zh_new: 阿斯塔特 MK VII 激光炮沿強力激光發射充能能量束，可在極遠距離切穿幾乎任何裝甲。不過射擊前需要相當長時間蓄能。可有效對付載具與建築。

en: Modified MK VIIc lascannon firing recalibrated energy charges which superheat a small area around the impact point, frequently causing the target additional harm.
zh_new: 改造 MK VIIc 激光炮可發射重新校準的能量彈，在衝擊點周圍形成小範圍過熱，經常對目標造成額外傷害。
notes: 2026-05-17 12:20 JST main chat wargear terminology cleanup

en: Astartes Mk V missile launcher. Armed with high-explosive krak missiles, this weapon is the bane of those feeling safe behind armored plating. Effective against vehicles and buildings.
zh_new: 阿斯塔特 MK V 導彈發射器。裝填高爆破甲導彈，是那些自以為躲在裝甲板後就很安全之人的剋星。可有效對付載具與建築。
notes: 2026-05-17 12:20 JST main chat wargear terminology cleanup

en: MK X ‘Hell’s Teeth’ Chainsword. A close-combat weapon of choice amongst the Adeptes Astartes, the chainsword’s monomolecular blades slice through most targets and its silhouette is a symbol of the Imperium. Effective against infantry and lightly armored enemies.
zh_new: MK X「地獄之牙」鏈鋸劍。這是阿斯塔特修會鍾愛的近戰武器，其單分子刃齒能切開多數目標，輪廓本身就是帝國的象徵。可有效對付步兵和輕裝甲敵人。
